visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a brightly lit kitchen. A person's hands are shown whisking a yellow egg mixture in a stainless steel bowl placed on a white marble countertop. (2) White flour is sifted into the bowl, and then a thick yellow paste is formed through vigorous whisking. A digital thermometer measures the temperature of milk in a pot on an induction cooktop. (3) The warm milk is poured into the paste and whisked until smooth. A woman in a dark grey apron dress is seen stirring a pot on the stove, where a yellow custard sauce thickens over heat. (4) The custard is transferred to a bowl containing butter and mixed. A large bowl of risen dough is pulled from a microwave oven. (5) On the marble counter, the dough is cut into pieces, weighed on a scale, and rolled into smooth balls. (6) Custard filling is carefully spooned into flattened dough discs, which are then pinched and pleated closed. (7) The buns are placed on a baking sheet, brushed with a glaze, and topped with a piped spiral of custard. (8) After baking in a black Sharp oven, the golden-brown buns are removed. The woman holds up a wire rack of the finished product, smiling at the camera. (9) Finally, a close-up shows one bun being torn apart to reveal the soft bread and creamy yellow custard filling.
